description: Optional services fail visibly and independently: with no Gmail connection and no AI provider key, the Gmail send paths and AI dispatch answer a structured 503 {code:'provider_not_configured'} while every Release 0 money route still answers 2xx in the same app and environment. Run from apps/server: npx vitest run test/optional-services-fail-visibly.integration.test.ts src/modules/ai/model-gateway.service.spec.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-07-vitest.json against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/optional-services-fail-visibly.json --report .proof/r0-07-vitest.json. allowAdditionalCases is true only because model-gateway.service.spec.ts also carries the pre-existing gateway suite (58 cases this packet does not own); requireReportSuccess keeps every one of them binding. RED-BEFORE on the R0 working branch before this packet: the eight Gmail 503 cases answer 400 BAD_REQUEST ('Gmail not connected' / 'Google OAuth not configured'), the AI chat case answers 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, and three of the four gateway cases fail (plain Error; no code on the stream error chunk).
